objectives.text: Steal the courier's letter from _inn_ in __inn_, and touch nothing else of his
Leave the false letter at _inn_ in its place
Bring the courier's letter to _qgiver_ in ___qgiver_

outcomes.text: The letters were switched, and the courier never knew.
You disturbed the courier's things and were caught. _qgiver_ never met you.
The courier rode on with the true letter.

objectives.text: Meet _qgiver_'s master at _meetingplace_
Fight your way out of ___dungeon_
Find _traitor_ and settle the score
Look for _traitor_ at _hidingplace_

outcomes.text: _traitor_ is dead. The gold was only ever bait.
_traitor_ got away with it.

objectives.text: Clear the monsters out of _house_ in __house_ before the day is out
Return to _qgiver_ in ___qgiver_ for your pay

outcomes.text: _qgiver_'s _house_ is free of monsters, and _qgiver_ is not ruined.
The monsters kept _house_, and _qgiver_ had to sell it.

objectives.text: Find _darkb_ and kill them. The townsfolk of ___questgiver_ know where to look.
Return to _questgiver_ in ___questgiver_ within the week for your pay

outcomes.text: _darkb_ is dead, _questgiver_ has their revenge, and the Brotherhood has your name.
_darkb_ still lives, and the Dark Brotherhood is after _questgiver_.

objectives.text: Be at _inn_ in six hours for your duel with _giver_
Defeat the champion _giver_ sent to fight you

branches.text: _giver_ takes offense in the street and wants your blood for it.

choices.text: Let it go and walk on

outcomes.text: _giver_'s champion lies dead at _inn_, and your honor is satisfied.
You walked away from a quarrel over words, and no blood was spilt.
You never came to _inn_, and _giver_ calls you a coward to anyone who will listen.

objectives.text: Visit _giver_'s sick cousin, _cousin_, in ___cousin_
Buy the cure from _healer_ in ___healer_ for 20 gold
Bring the Talisman to _cousin_ in ___cousin_ before it is too late. It cures only once.

outcomes.text: _cousin_ is cured of Wizard Bane, and _giver_ will never forget it.
_cousin_ died of Wizard Bane.

objectives.text: Ask around ___giver_ who took _giver_'s first printing of _book_
Track down _thief_ and take back _book_
Return _book_ to _giver_ in ___giver_

outcomes.text: _giver_ has the first printing back and tells everyone who found it.
_giver_ gave up and bought another copy.

objectives.text: Deliver _questgiver_'s package to _pickuplocal_ in ___pickuplocal_ by this time tomorrow
Take the package back from the thief

branches.text: A thief who overheard _questgiver_ demands the package.

outcomes.text: You fought off a thief and still delivered the package on time.
You gave the package up to a thief, took it back, and delivered it after all.
_pickuplocal_ has the package, and you have your pay.
You handed _questgiver_'s package to a thief, and _pickuplocal_ never got it.
The package never reached _pickuplocal_.

objectives.text: Deliver _questgiver_'s package to _pickupregion_ in ___pickupregion_ in time
Take the package back from the thief

branches.text: A thief on the road knows what you carry and demands it.

outcomes.text: You fought off a thief on the road and still delivered the package.
You gave the package up to a thief, took it back, and delivered it after all.
_pickupregion_ has the package, and you have your pay.
You handed _questgiver_'s package to a thief, and it never reached ___pickupregion_.
The package never reached ___pickupregion_.

objectives.text: Ask _friend1_ and _friend2_ what became of _missingperson_
Bring _missingperson_ out of hiding at _hidingplace_
Fight off Smiley's gang
Tell _questgiver_ in ___questgiver_ what became of _missingperson_

outcomes.text: _missingperson_ was dragged home to _questgiver_, protesting all the way.
_missingperson_ was hiding in _hidingplace_, and _questgiver_ has gone to fetch them.
_missingperson_ was caught stealing from a temple and sits in jail.
_missingperson_ left town after a quarrel with _friend3_ and has not been seen since.
_missingperson_ was killed by Smiley's gang, and _questgiver_ grieves.
_questgiver_ knows at last what became of _missingperson_.
No one found _missingperson_ in time.

objectives.text: Escort _questgiver_ safely to _destination_ in __destination_
Fight off the hunters who want _questgiver_

branches.text: Armed hunters demand you turn _questgiver_ over to them.

choices.text: Stand and fight for your client

outcomes.text: You fought off the hunters and brought _questgiver_ safely to _destination_.
You brought _questgiver_ safely to _destination_.
You turned _questgiver_ over to the hunters and watched your client die.
_questgiver_ gave up on you and went on alone.
_questgiver_ never reached _destination_.

objectives.text: Be at _qgiverhome_ between nine and midnight, when the assassins come
Kill both assassins
Speak to _qgiver_

branches.text: _qgiver_ will need every coin if they come again for the land.

choices.text: Keep it, and spend it on holding on to your land

outcomes.text: The assassins are dead, _qgiver_ is safe, and you were paid as agreed.
The assassins are dead, and _qgiver_ kept the gold to hold on to the land.
The assassins found _qgiver_ without you.

objectives.text: Take the flowers to _spouse_ in ___spouse_ and ask after _hermit_
Take _spouse_'s book to _teacher_ in __school_
Find _hermit_ in ___dungeon_ and show them the riddle
Bring _hermit_'s answer to _qgiver_ in ___qgiver_

branches.text: _qgiver_ has the answer, and a wedding to pay for.

choices.text: Keep it as a wedding gift for the couple

outcomes.text: _qgiver_ knows the answer is kindness, and _spouse_ will marry them.
_qgiver_ learned kindness twice over: from the riddle, and from you.
Three months passed, and _spouse_ married another.

objectives.text: Meet _master_ at _meetingplace_ in __meetingplace_
Fight your way out of ___dungeon_
Find the orc shaman and settle the score
Look for the orc shaman at _hidingplace_ in __hidingplace_

branches.text: _qgiver_ sent you into the trap, and offers gold to keep it quiet.

choices.text: Take the gold and let _qgiver_ go
Tell the guard how _qgiver_ sold you to an orc

outcomes.text: The orc shaman is dead, and _qgiver_'s gold bought your silence.
The orc shaman is dead, and the guard knows who lured you into its trap.
The orc shaman who wore _master_'s face is dead.
The orc shaman got away with it.

objectives.text: Buy the _item_ from _merchant_ at _store_ for 20 gold
Bring the _item_ to _sister_ instead, as she begs
Bring the _item_ to _questg_ in ___questg_ before _sister_'s birthday

outcomes.text: _sister_ warned you what the _item_ was for, and you sold it to _questg_ anyway.
_questg_ has the _item_ for the celebration, and you have your pay.
You gave the _item_ to _sister_, and her brother's poison will never be brewed.
You handed the _item_ to _sister_ herself, and _questg_ paid you nothing.
The birthday came and went without the _item_.

objectives.text: Find out who is behind the rumors about _giver_ in ___giver_
Find the letter _giver_ had from _sister_ and show it to _giver_
Rescue _lover_ from ___dungeon_
See _lover_ home to _sistershouse_ in __sistershouse_

branches.text: _lover_ wants the letter that damns _giver_ and _sister_.

outcomes.text: _lover_ is home, his sword is yours, and _giver_ and _sister_ are his to deal with.
_lover_ is home, and the letter that damns _giver_ and _sister_ went to the magistrate.
The rumors about _giver_ were never put to rest.

objectives.text: Find the daedric _ingredient_ somewhere in ___dungeon_
Bring the daedric _ingredient_ to _qgiver_ at _meetingplace_
Use the guardian's token on _qgiver_ at _meetingplace_
Kill the orc shaman behind _qgiver_'s face

branches.text: The daedra guarding the _ingredient_ warns that _qgiver_ means to kill you.

choices.text: Spare the guardian and take its token

outcomes.text: You broke the impostor's illusion with the guardian's token, and the Mages Guild trusts you more.
You took the guardian's token and killed it anyway, and its masters will not forget.
The orc shaman behind _qgiver_'s face is dead. There was never any _artifact_.
_agent_'s client never got the daedric _ingredient_.

objectives.text: Free _child_ from the Dark Brotherhood at _dbguild_ in __dbguild_
Bring _child_ home to _qgiver_ in ___qgiver_

outcomes.text: _child_ is home, alive and well.
The Dark Brotherhood kept _child_.

objectives.text: Escort _qgiver_ to _betrothedhome_ in __betrothedhome_ to fetch _betrothed_
See the couple safely to _priest_ at _temple_ in __temple_

outcomes.text: _qgiver_ and _betrothed_ are wed, out of _ruler_'s reach for good.
_betrothed_ was forced to wed _ruler_.

objectives.text: Take the package to _dummy_ in ___dummy_
Ask around about the _finger_, and show it to someone learned in curses
Destroy the mummy in its tomb in ___dungeon_ to end the curse

branches.text: The curse ends at the mummy's tomb, or it follows the _finger_ to whoever holds it next.

choices.text: Destroy the mummy in its tomb
Pass the _finger_ on to a stranger

outcomes.text: The mummy is destroyed in its tomb, and its curse with it.
You passed the _finger_ on to a stranger, and the curse went with it.
A thousand and one nights passed, and the curse ran its course.
The mummy still walks at midnight.
